name: FFS, Another Northern Duke
source:
Expelled from the modern world into a novel, you occupy the body of a minor villainess, on her way to marry the beastly Duke of the North.

(Why does that sound familiar...)

Your mission? To have him fall for you. Should be easy, right? 

Or maybe this is all a dream?

You decide.

[From [url=https://chthonicchromestudio.itch.io/ffs-another-northern-duke-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你被從現代世界拋進一本小說，佔據了一個小配角的身體。她是個惡役千金，此刻正要去嫁給傳聞中野獸般的北境公爵。

（這情節怎麼好像在哪兒見過……）

你的任務？讓他愛上你。應該不難，對吧？

也許，這一切都只是個夢？

由你決定。

〔摘自[url=https://chthonicchromestudio.itch.io/ffs-another-northern-duke-demo]itch.io[/url]〕
